definitions.explanation: A sound in the low frequency range. Used for music, voices, and audio equipment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低音|ていおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魅力的|みりょくてき}→魅力的：04799_miryokuteki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スピーカー→スピーカー：04420_supiikaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低音|ていおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。

{低音|ていおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振動|しんどう}→振動：08179_shindou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わって→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧くる。
examples.english: When you listen to music with deep bass, you can feel the vibrations in your body.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧ (low) + {音|おん} (sound). Used in music, audio equipment, and voice descriptions. The opposite is ⟦{高音|こうおん}→高音：19946_kouon⟧ (high-pitched sound).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低音|ていおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (a low voice)
- {低音|ていおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧ (the bass resonates)
- {低音|ていおん}{域|いき} (bass range)
- {重|おも}{低音|ていおん} (deep bass)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高音|こうおん}→高音：19946_kouon⟧: high-pitched sound — the antonym
- ⟦{低温|ていおん}→低温：29339_teion⟧: low temperature — a homophone with different kanji
